events.title: Diwali at the Library
events.description: Winsor Room - Please register in advance - All ages Celebrate Diwali at Radnor Memorial Library! Families are invited to join us in celebrating Diwali - India's Festival of Lights. Come enjoy fun craft activities, music and dancing, and tasty refreshments.

events.title: Ghouls Night Out
events.description: Adult, Teens, and Tweens are invited to attend Ghouls Night Out at the Langhorne Library! From 4-5pm, we will be offering a craft session of making ghost figurines out of air-dry clay. Shortly after 5pm, a showing of the movie Casper (PG | 1995 | 1h 40) will take place! Feel free to attend both fun and free events or just stay for one!
